name: Scroll of Firebolt
description: Written in a hurry by someone who then left the room. It is not a good sign when the margins are singed.
notes: A scroll of Firebolt (mw-ju8.4), spell.firebolt. Intended to cast that spell once when read and be consumed. That read-and-cast path does not exist yet (no spell content or cast pipeline: mw-e06.2), so for now it is a stock item with no effect and teaches nothing; a follow-up bead wires it. Base value 90 sits in the economy scroll band (40-150).
